meta.classification: SYNTHETIC SIMULATION, NOT REAL USER FEEDBACK
meta.scope: Concept-only parent panel. No application, source code, live site, screenshot, analytics, or real parent interview was supplied or inspected. No implementation claims.
meta.independence: Each persona is a separate first-pass scenario with a distinct context and concern. All responses were generated by one AI author. This is perspective separation, NOT independent human recruitment, independent model runs, blind moderation, empirical validation or saturation.

panel.task: Find the next action without already knowing recruiting terminology.
panel.concern: Do not imply a calendar event guarantees coach contact or an offer.
panel.request: Show my next task with a plain-language reason and a source.

panel.persona: Soccer parent, club and school seasons
panel.task: Coordinate two households without exposing private notes.
panel.concern: One universal recruiting timeline could mislead us.
panel.request: Separate club, school and recruiting events and let us control sharing.

panel.persona: Basketball parent, boys and girls programs
panel.task: Switch athletes without carrying the wrong dates or contacts.
panel.concern: I could message a coach from the wrong child’s profile.
panel.request: Keep the athlete name visible through every consequential action.

panel.task: Check travel plans and deadlines when connection drops.
panel.concern: An old cached deadline could look current.
panel.request: Show offline status and when each item was last checked.

panel.task: Compare realistic camp costs before registering elsewhere.
panel.concern: A low listed price could omit lodging or fees.
panel.request: Show known total costs, unknown costs and cancellation terms.

panel.context: Individual events and changing performance results
panel.task: Track event-specific results without comparing unlike events.
panel.concern: A metric without units or timing method is meaningless.
panel.request: Record event, units, result date and measurement context.

panel.context: Uses screen reader; family manages multiple meets
panel.task: Read the schedule and add a task without sight.
panel.concern: A beautiful calendar can be unusable with screen-reader navigation.
panel.request: Offer a structured agenda with spoken labels and status announcements.

panel.task: Read dates and eligibility notes at high zoom on a phone.
panel.concern: Color alone cannot tell me a deadline is urgent.
panel.request: Keep text readable with no lost controls and label urgency in words.

panel.task: Create, move and cancel a reminder without dragging.
panel.concern: A tiny icon or drag-only card blocks the task.
panel.request: Provide keyboard actions, visible focus and adequately sized targets.

panel.context: Captions needed; athlete wants control of disclosure
panel.task: Identify relevant programs without assuming disability determines eligibility.
panel.concern: Publishing medical details or implying eligibility could harm my child.
panel.request: Make access needs private, optional and distinct from verified eligibility.

criteria.requirement: Support a neutral sport selector with football, soccer, basketball, baseball, softball, volleyball, track, cross-country, swimming, tennis, golf, wrestling, adaptive sport and Other.
criteria.acceptance: Select every option, including Other; it persists on reload and never silently maps to another sport.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Keep recruiting milestones keyed to sport, program category, governing association and season.
criteria.acceptance: Two synthetic sports with different fixture dates display their own dates; no default date leaks into the other profile.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Show the source, checked date and uncertainty for every rule-derived deadline.
criteria.acceptance: Open a deadline: source link, checked date and applicable scope are present; unsourced fixture is visibly Unverified.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Scope tasks, contacts, results and reminders to one athlete.
criteria.acceptance: Create two fictional athletes; switching profiles cannot reveal or edit the other athlete’s records.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Allow relevant program categories without inferring gender, ability or eligibility from the sport.
criteria.acceptance: Change category explicitly; displayed scope updates and eligibility remains unverified until backed by a source.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Differentiate school, club, camp and recruiting events.
criteria.acceptance: Add overlapping fixtures; agenda names each type and flags the overlap without deleting either event.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Store event-specific performance units and measurement context.
criteria.acceptance: Save a track time and a swimming time; each retains event, distance, units, date and timing context; no cross-event ranking is inferred.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Offer adaptive-sport and Other pathways without automatic exclusion.
criteria.acceptance: Select adaptive sport: program search stays usable, classification is optional and no medical disclosure is required.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Display event time zone and preserve the actual instant when travel changes the viewing zone.
criteria.acceptance: A synthetic event near daylight-saving change retains its UTC instant across two zones; ambiguous local times require explicit offset selection.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Separate known fees, travel estimates and unknown expenses.
criteria.acceptance: A camp fixture with missing lodging shows Unknown, not zero; cancellation policy is linked or marked unavailable.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Pair each milestone with a concrete next step and jargon explanation.
criteria.acceptance: A first-time reader can locate the action, reason and optional glossary without leaving the agenda; no offer guarantee appears.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish planning guidance from recruiting, scholarship and eligibility decisions.
criteria.acceptance: Review generated guidance fixtures: all unsupported promises are absent; uncertainty and responsible source are shown.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Let families preview, enable, change and disable reminders per athlete.
criteria.acceptance: Create a fixture reminder, inspect recipient/time/zone, cancel it, and verify no subsequent delivery is queued.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Export events with stable identifiers, time zones and updates/cancellations.
criteria.acceptance: Import fixture ICS into a test calendar, update then cancel; the original event changes rather than creating duplicates.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Provide a cached agenda with explicit offline and last-sync status.
criteria.acceptance: Disconnect after a sync: cached events remain readable; unsaved edits show Pending and rule updates are never described as current.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Support independent household access and least-privilege sharing.
criteria.acceptance: Invite a fixture viewer: private notes are absent, edits are denied, and revocation removes access on a fresh session.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Keep athlete profiles private by default and require explicit preview before sharing.
criteria.acceptance: New fictional minor profile is inaccessible to unauthenticated visitors; preview lists exactly the fields included in a shared view.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Provide optional sensitive fields plus correction, export and deletion controls.
criteria.acceptance: Skip disability/medical fields and finish onboarding; export contains only fixture data; deletion removes it from normal access and states retention limits.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Support all core workflows without a pointer, including alternatives to dragging.
criteria.acceptance: Using keyboard only, add/edit/move/delete a task and switch athletes; no trap occurs and focus returns logically after dialogs.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Use persistent visible focus, meaningful headings, landmarks and named controls.
criteria.acceptance: Inspect the accessibility tree and tab through controls: each has a useful name, focus is visible and not hidden by sticky content.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Provide a chronological agenda alternative with understandable dates and context.
criteria.acceptance: With VoiceOver/Safari and NVDA/Firefox, read and create a fixture event; date, athlete, sport, time zone and status are announced in sensible order.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Announce save errors, loading completion and successful changes without stealing focus.
criteria.acceptance: Trigger validation and save a fixture task with a screen reader; each relevant status is announced once and entered data is retained.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and never rely on color alone.
criteria.acceptance: Measure normal text at least 4.5:1, large text 3:1 and required UI/state indicators 3:1; grayscale still exposes priority/status in text or shape.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Keep core content and controls available at 200 percent text resize and 320 CSS-pixel width.
criteria.acceptance: Test both conditions: no clipped labels, inaccessible controls or horizontal page scrolling except genuinely two-dimensional content with an agenda alternative.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Provide targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or documented WCAG-compliant spacing; prefer 44 by 44 for primary mobile actions.
criteria.acceptance: Measure primary and secondary targets on mobile; all satisfy the minimum or valid spacing exception, and risky adjacent actions remain distinguishable.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Respect reduced-motion preferences and avoid flashing or compulsory animation.
criteria.acceptance: Enable prefers-reduced-motion: nonessential transitions stop; no content flashes more than three times per second; workflow remains complete.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Provide accurate captions for meaningful video and text alternatives for meaningful visuals/audio.
criteria.acceptance: Inspect a fixture explainer: captions include meaningful sound, transcript covers audio content and diagram has equivalent text; no information requires hearing.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Use explicit labels, format hints, linked errors and preserved inputs.
criteria.acceptance: Submit invalid dates with a screen reader: the error identifies the field and correction, focus reaches the problem and other entries remain intact.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Break onboarding into short steps with saved progress and a review screen.
criteria.acceptance: Leave midway and return: prior fixture answers remain; progress is named in text and review allows correction before any sharing.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.

criteria.requirement: Allow password-manager use, paste and an accessible recovery path without cognitive-only puzzles.
criteria.acceptance: Complete sign-in and recovery using keyboard and a password manager; paste works; any anti-bot challenge has an accessible alternative and errors disclose no other account data.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Executed test steps plus observed result and relevant screenshot or accessibility-tree evidence; fixtures are synthetic.
